name: tutorial_prepare
note: Sequence state 0x20 handler (entry 0x20D338 of the state table 0x20D2B8; no direct callers): prepares a Roboy tutorial. thiscall this=SEQ, no arguments. chapter_select.c's chs_tutorial_prepare replaces it with a story-stage entry (state 0x1C) when RECOMP_CHAPTER_SELECT is set or a RECOMP_CHAPTER_JUMP is pending.

name: sequence_frame
note: The sequence object's per-frame update (vtable 0x1CCEB8 slot 1): dispatches SEQ+0x48 through 0x20D2B8 and ticks the play time (0x3A900). thiscall this=SEQ, no arguments. chapter_select.c's chj_sequence_frame watches the live mission for RECOMP_CHAPTER_JUMP, then does the same dispatch.
